name: Five-second VR.net matrix-parameter versus self-report regression
window_origin: first finite source timestamp in each session
timestamp_policy: infer epoch seconds/milliseconds/microseconds by magnitude; record per source
rotation_rate_flag_policy: quality flag only; does not automatically reject artificial camera rotations
camera_selection: first valid camera then fixed name for session; prefer Main then Center then first
acceleration: norm of difference between three-dimensional interval velocity vectors divided by their midpoint time difference
rotation_rate: shortest relative SO(3) rotation angle / interval seconds; degrees/second
matrix_convention: observed serialized row-vector layout; inverse view translation at row 3; fixed camera-space Z reflection removed
fov: full asymmetric perspective frustum opening from projection diagonal and offsets; unsupported skew/orthographic projection is missing
object_count: number of valid serialized 4x4 m_matrix entries; no deduplication; not total scene GameObjects
label_pairing: nearest real MS_rating to window midpoint within same session; earlier report wins an exact tie
future_labels: allowed by nearest rule; signed time distance and future flag retained; not prospective prediction
standard_deviation: sample standard deviation ddof=1; missing for fewer than two finite observations
model: LightGBM regressor; 100 trees, learning_rate .05, num_leaves 7, max_depth 3, min_child_samples 20, reg_lambda 1, n_jobs 2
validation: Leave-One-Game-Out; all windows in a game remain in one fold
preprocessing: training-fold median imputation and VarianceThreshold(1e-10); no test-game standardization
fit_weights: equal session total weight; within session equal rating-event weight; within event equal window weight
auc: derived binary ROC-AUC: actual MS_rating>2; ranking score=continuous regression prediction; no calibration claim
shap: TreeSHAP of final all-data fitted model; fitted explanations, not out-of-fold evidence or causal effects
limitations: runtime camera motion includes user head motion
source coordinate units not independently certified metres
game count determined only from local sampled_csv
runtime graphics do not establish authored design settings
protocol_gate: supplementary raw-score regression; does not evaluate or pass original three-class AUC gate
